reviews.text: Thank you for your kind and attentive care during the final stages of my elderly cat's life.
The doctor was thorough and kind, so I felt completely at ease entrusting my care to them.
This is a wonderful animal hospital overflowing with love for cats.

The director is very careful with his treatment and has a kind personality, and my dog ​​loves him. We moved farther away and tried many other animal hospitals, but none of them were a good fit, so we continue to go here even after moving. Not only the director, but all the nurses are also kind and gentle, and even though it's a hospital, my dog ​​immediately wants to go there. When paying, they are kind enough to explain things like insurance eligibility, and are considerate of the burden on pet owners.
I am thinking of moving again, but I am hesitant because I think I won't be able to go to Komaba Pet Clinic any more.

My 4-month-old puppy (Toy Poodle) accidentally swallowed a pain relief patch, so we rushed him in for his first consultation. Thanks to the thorough examination, explanation, and treatment, he successfully vomited it up. We are grateful for your prompt response. Thank you very much for everything. We will be even more careful about the risk of accidental ingestion in the future. We would be happy to use your services again if anything comes up.

Dr. Furuta ♡
It's been a long time! How are you?
I've been requesting your services for many years, ever since you were at another clinic before you opened your own practice. Thank you so much for taking such good care of my six Chihuahuas, especially the last five.
When my nearly 15-year-old high-senior mama needed emergency surgery, other doctors told me, "She's extremely old, so there's a risk and surgery isn't recommended..."
I was devastated to learn that she would rupture inside her abdomen if we didn't do anything.
But in that situation, only Dr. Furuta said...
"I'll do my best! To be honest, this is my first time performing surgery on a dog of this age, but we'll do the surgery on a day when several other doctors are on duty, so if anything happens, we can all cooperate! They are all excellent doctors, so please don't worry! We will all do our best! Let's choose the day with the best environment for the surgery!"
He said all of this so strongly. I still vividly remember the doctor's earnest gaze and how he teared up when he spoke to me, moved by my own tears.

Thanks to the successful surgery, my dog ​​lived a long and healthy life afterward.

Thank you so much!

Even after you opened your practice... you were always so kind and attentive during checkups and phone calls until the very end of all my dogs' lives, and it was a great comfort to me every time!

During health checkups, you even gave me handwritten notes with easy-to-understand explanations and illustrations. They were so cute and made me so happy; I smiled every time I read them...lol. I still cherish them.

Thanks to you, my last five Chihuahuas...🐶17 years 10 months🐶16 years 8 months🐶17 years 5 months🐶15 years 14 days🐶18 years 10 months... all lived long and fulfilling lives♡
Dr. Furuta is a lifesaver for my dogs!

Thank you so much for all your help.

*I'm still grieving the loss of my pet, but...
I'm doing well thanks to my fan activities! Lol
I hope to see you, my kind doctor, your wife, the nurses, and you again someday.

...It's the changing of the seasons, so I imagine you'll be busy... Please take care of yourself ♡
Sorry for the long message... Even this isn't enough to express my gratitude.
The clinic director and nurses are truly kind. They listen to your concerns attentively, which makes you feel very at ease.
Kindness of both doctors. Highly recommend

This is the head veterinarian who fought alongside us and helped us through that life-or-death period at the beginning of this year. I realized I hadn't properly thanked him, and now that he's about to turn 13, I'd like to express my gratitude once again. Thank you so much for everything for the rest of his life!
The clinic director is very caring and kind.

The veterinarian and staff are all very kind. The veterinarian always listens attentively to all kinds of concerns and offers various solutions. This is the best veterinary clinic I've ever been to. You can feel the veterinarian's love for animals.
